# Tomorrow

Tomorrow applies the Tomorrow color scheme to Obsidian, covering both syntax highlighting and interface styling. The recorded description characterises the palette as balanced with soft contrast, intended to keep notes and code clear during long sessions, and states nothing about supported modes or settings.

![Tomorrow screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deudz/obsidian-tomorrow-theme/HEAD/res/thumb.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Tomorrow"
    author: "deudz"
    repo:   "deudz/obsidian-tomorrow-theme"
    slug:   "tomorrow"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/tomorrow"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/deudz/obsidian-tomorrow-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deudz/obsidian-tomorrow-theme/HEAD/res/thumb.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply the Tomorrow color scheme to Obsidian for consistent, readable syntax highlighting and UI styling. Use a balanced palette and soft contrast to keep notes and code clear during long sessions."
}
```
